title: The SEO rescue: Recover your website after a Google penalty
body:
Has your website completely disappeared from Google overnight?

An algorithm update (Core Update) hits and, without warning, your company's traffic drops by 90%. Your main keywords no longer appear even on the third page, and your phone stops ringing. This usually happens when previous agencies used outdated ranking tactics to artificially inflate your metrics quickly. Now, Google has caught on, and your digital business is on life support.

The trap of Ignoring the Problem and Keeping Publishing

Many believe that by creating more articles or redesigning the website, they will magically recover their rankings. But if your domain is marked as toxic by the algorithm, nothing you publish will have any effect. Trying to accelerate in a car with the parking brake on only destroys the engine.

Our solution: Forensic Audit and EEAT Protocol

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we apply an emergency rescue. We analyze your complete history to identify the trigger of the penalty and purge the toxic elements blocking your visibility.

  1. Toxic Link Disavowal: We use advanced tools to identify and block artificial or spammy backlinks (Disavow tool) pointing to your domain.
  2. Content Pruning: We remove or rewrite duplicate, thin, or low-quality AI-generated content that dilutes your authority.
  3. EEAT Optimization: We inject signals of Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, and Trustworthiness through Schema markup to prove to Google you are a real, legitimate business.
  4. Core Technical Restructuring: We fix severe crawling and indexing errors that aggravate the penalty at the source code level.

The Real Impact on your Profitability

  • Blacklist Exit: Your domain is crawled and indexed normally again, removing the algorithmic spam label.
  • Lost Traffic Recovery: You recapture the B2B clients you had lost, regaining your business volume prior to the drop.
  • Immunity to Future Updates: We build an SEO foundation so solid and ethical that upcoming algorithm changes will benefit you instead of sinking you.
